liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the performance of Deal as a standout moment [15]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer calls the transition from Bertha to Sugar Magnolia a show stopper [15]
- Reviewer praises Garcia's pedal steel guitar additions during the performance [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-07-24.138228.AKG460omni.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 35 songs; 230 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1987-07-24.pzm.russjcan.92568.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 36 songs; 222 min; rated 4.33/5 by 15 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes the P.A. system is very clear and captures interesting crowd chatter; Reviewer praises the capture quality, noting the use of head-mounted microphones; Reviewer describes the sound as superb but finds the Dylan set hard to listen to [8][9][10]
- **gd1987-07-24.sbdAud.dad.97493.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 14 songs; 84 min; rated 3.92/5 by 13 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer considers this the highest quality among available Dylan and Dead uploads; Reviewer states Bob Dylan was significantly out of tune throughout the performance; Reviewer describes the sound as raw and gritty, with the Dead sounding great [17][18][19]
- **gd1987-07-24.167404.set3.aud.ebay.andrewf.flac2448**: audience recording; 14 songs; 83 min [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes Jerry Garcia played pedal steel during the show [19]
- Bob Dylan performed on guitar during the third set [6]
- Most songs were short, with only one exceeding ten minutes in duration [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-07-24.138228.AKG460omni.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rick Gastwirk; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: AKG 460 omni > Sony PCM-F1 > Dat; Recorded Fob; From the collection of Rich Gastwirt; Transfer: Dat > Sony PCM-R500 > Sound Devices 744T > wav 16/44.1;… [1]. Also: Uploader lists the full setlist, including specific song transitions and encores [1]
- **gd1987-07-24.pzm.russjcan.92568.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Russ Cansler; transferred by Russ Cansler; source: Hat-Mounted Realistic PZM's > Sony WMD6-C > MAC (Maxell MX 90, no nr) [2]. Also: Recording was released by Grateful Dead Vault on DVD or CD; Uploader digitized the show from a DVD to avoid physical media handling; Recording was made using hat-mounted microphones [2][9][13][14][15]
- **gd1987-07-24.sbdAud.dad.97493.flac16**: source: Primary source: Soundboard Sony multi-track PCM master > mixdown cassette [recorded on Sony TCD5M] > Sony F1 PCM Beta tape > Beta PCM clone > CD [digital… [4]
- **gd1987-07-24.167404.set3.aud.ebay.andrewf.flac2448**: taped by Unknown (eBay liberated cassette tape); transferred by Andrew F. 04/2024; source: AUD > ? > Cassette, liberated from ebay. [6]. Also: Uploader notes this source does not match current audio sources [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Stadium - July 24, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-24-1987) [21]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1987-07-24 Fri Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum Stadium, Oakland, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1396549743943/grateful-dead-1987-07-24-fri-oakland) [22]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Stadium - July 24, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-24-1987) [23]
